title: Three black mana changed a bad block
era: 1996 U.S. Nationals Mono-Black Necropotence representative play
story: My opponent sent Kird Ape into combat with a Taiga in play, making the Ape a 2/3. I blocked with Order of the Ebon Hand , my 2/1 black creature. Three untapped Swamp s gave me the choice to fight rather than lose the Order. I paid one black to give it first strike and two more to pump it to 3/1. Order struck for three first-strike damage and killed the Ape before the Ape could hit back. My Necropotence remained in play. Protection from white wasn't what won this fight; timing and black mana were.
review: Kird Ape + Taiga Forest type -> 2/3. Order 2/1 spends B first strike and BB to pump 3/1, first strike lethal 3 against Ape; no normal retaliation. 3 Swamps and Necropotence in actual source deck.
claim: representative reconstruction; not a historical match or quotation
